tools.name: assettiger_list_assets
tools.description: List assets with optional filters by category, site, location, department, person or customer, plus search and paging. Good first call to find a refId. GET /v1/assets.

tools.name: assettiger_get_asset
tools.description: Get one asset by refId, with its details and, if asked, its current event and custom fields. GET /v1/assets/{refId}.

tools.name: assettiger_get_asset_events
tools.description: List the events of one asset (check-outs, check-ins, repairs, lost, broken and others). GET /v1/assets/{refId}/events.

tools.name: assettiger_get_asset_history
tools.description: Get the change history of one asset, optionally between two dates. GET /v1/assets/{refId}/histories.

tools.name: assettiger_list_sites
tools.description: List sites (physical places an organisation owns or rents). GET /v1/sites.

tools.name: assettiger_list_locations
tools.description: List the locations (rooms, shelves, areas) inside one site. GET /v1/locations?siteRefId=.

tools.name: assettiger_list_persons
tools.description: List persons (staff or users who can hold assets). GET /v1/persons.

tools.name: assettiger_list_customers
tools.description: List customers (external parties that can hold assets). GET /v1/customers.

tools.name: assettiger_list_maintenances
tools.description: List maintenance records, optionally for one site or location. GET /v1/maintenances.

tools.name: assettiger_list_contracts
tools.description: List contracts. Needs the Contracts feature on the customer's plan. GET /v1/contracts.

tools.name: assettiger_list_inventories
tools.description: List consumable inventory items (stock lines), with search and paging. Needs the Inventory feature on the plan. GET /v1/inventories.

tools.name: assettiger_get_inventory_stock_summary
tools.description: Get the stock summary (quantities in and out) of one inventory item. GET /v1/inventories/{refId}/stocksummary.

tools.name: assettiger_create_asset
tools.description: Create one asset in the organisation's AssetTiger account. assetTagId and description are required. Creates a new record each call, so do not retry blindly. POST /v1/assets/add.

tools.name: assettiger_check_out_asset
tools.description: Check an asset out to a person, a customer or a site/location. Sends no email unless sendEmail is true. POST /v1/assets/{refId}/events/checkout/add.

tools.name: assettiger_check_in_asset
tools.description: Return a checked-out asset and optionally move it to a new site, location or department. Sends no email unless sendEmail is true. POST /v1/assets/{refId}/events/checkin/add.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: assettiger_check_out_asset, assettiger_check_in_asset · Private data: assettiger_list_maintenances, assettiger_create_asset · Public sink: assettiger_create_asset, assettiger_check_out_asset, assettiger_check_in_asset.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: assettiger_check_out_asset, assettiger_check_in_asset · Private data: assettiger_list_maintenances, assettiger_create_asset · Public sink: assettiger_create_asset, assettiger_check_out_asset, assettiger_check_in_asset

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
